primary_outcome: At least five raw scores >=90 in a single six-world batch with timely submissions, complete independent evaluation and complete usage; all failed attempts retained.

changes_from_r13: Optional general affine-position single-frequency harmonic diagnostics, trained only on acquired observations; full independent coefficients and free frequency before any compression.
Optional fresh diagnosis of the selected training probes when a fitted law has large noise-free residuals. No extra observations, no alteration of fitted law, no automatic submission.
r16.interpretation: Composite engineering experiment. Original E3 main prompt, ordinary fit/evaluator and world physics unchanged; no per-world answer map.
r16.condition: Run after R14/R15 and source review while the 27B same-model five-world target is unmet. A 122B batch is recorded separately and does not substitute for 27B reproduction.

r14.note: Original r13-r14-protocol remains applicable. Launch while optional next-version implementation is being developed locally; do not deploy new science until both batches are audited.

r15.interpretation: Single additional complete-batch repeat, all outcomes retained; no cross-world best selection.

r17.condition: Run only if R14 does not meet the single-batch five-world target, concurrently with R16 after source review.
r17.difference_from_r14: diagnostics_harmonic and diagnostics_on_fit enabled; same model, seed, sampling and serving configuration.
r17.interpretation: Composite numerical-assistance experiment, paired by configuration with R14; not a same-model 27B result.

closeout.reason: User requested experimental closeout before either proposed batch launched. Optional implementation is tested; performance benefit remains unmeasured.
